## Appearance

Morgan is a short, stout lady with gray hair who wears a tweed suit.

_Sources: [v2 XX The Way It Often Happens P22](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0022)_

## Personality

A widely traveled individual, Morgan possesses great talent as a storyteller and is a delightful conversationalist. Beneath a brilliant exterior lies a kindhearted nature that easily earns the affection of others.

_Sources: [v2 XX The Way It Often Happens P42](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0042)_

## History

Mrs. Morgan was a famous author known for writing 'Edgewood Days' and 'The Rosebud Garden', as well as the aunt of [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md). During a visit to [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md) on the [Island](../codex/places.md#island), she unexpectedly arrived at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) alongside [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md) and Mrs. [Pendexter](../character/pendexter.md).

_Sources: [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P5](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0005), [v2 XX The Way It Often Happens P22](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0022), [v2 XX The Way It Often Happens P33](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0033), [v2 XX The Way It Often Happens P42](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0042), [v2 XX The Way It Often Happens P43](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0043)_

## Relationships

### [Pendexter](../character/pendexter.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/morgan--pendexter.md)

Mrs. [Pendexter](../character/pendexter.md) is a friend of Mrs. Morgan who accompanies her on social outings. The two visited [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) together when [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md) brought them to meet [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), where they enjoyed a dinner and a walk despite Anne's initial embarrassment over her dyed nose.

_Sources: [v2 XX The Way It Often Happens P22](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0022), [v2 XX The Way It Often Happens P24](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0024), [v2 XX The Way It Often Happens P33](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0033), +2 more_

- Friend of — friends visiting together  <sub>[v2 XX The Way It Often Happens P24](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0024)</sub>

### [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/morgan--priscilla-grant.md)

[Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md) is Mrs. Morgan's niece. [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md) arranged and brought Mrs. Morgan, alongside Mrs. [Pendexter](../character/pendexter.md), to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) for a surprise visit to meet [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md).

_Sources: [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P5](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0005), [v2 XVII A Chapter of Accidents P63](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0063), [v2 XX The Way It Often Happens P22](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0022), +4 more_
